'''Hora Graneet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Navy/Legends|navy]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Battle Lance]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Hora Graneet was the nephew of [[Tenn Graneet]], an [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunner]] in who had previously served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Out of admiration for his uncle, Graneet enlisted in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and served as a member of the deck crew aboard the ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer, ''Battle Lance''.<ref name="DSn" />

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Destruction Date"/> the ''Battle Lance'', having been equipped with an experimental [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter reactor]], disintegrated while in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], killing Graneet, along with the rest of the crew. Tenn, who considered Hora to be his favorite nephew, felt personally responsible for his death.<ref name="DSn" />
